_note: Synthetic labelled complaint pairs. overlap=true means both describe the same underlying allegation. Hard negatives (same topic area, different allegation) are included on purpose. Written by the SAMANVAY team; no real complaints.

pairs.a: Students are being charged unauthorized examination fees.
pairs.b: The institution is collecting excess examination charges.

pairs.a: Management is charging a fee of Rs 15000 for re-evaluation which is not approved.
pairs.b: Unapproved re-evaluation charges are being collected from every student.

pairs.a: Original certificates are withheld until the full fee is paid.
pairs.b: College refuses to give the degree certificate after course completion.

pairs.a: Management took donation for admission to management quota seats.
pairs.b: Seats were sold for capitation fee during counselling.

pairs.a: Most faculty members in the mechanical department do not have a postgraduate degree.
pairs.b: Teachers hired are not qualified as per norms, many lack a masters qualification.

pairs.a: The laboratories have no working equipment for the electronics course.
pairs.b: Lab facilities are missing and equipment is broken in the electronics labs.

pairs.a: Senior students are ragging first year students in the hostel.
pairs.b: First year students are being harassed and bullied by seniors in the hostel.

pairs.a: The college is running a course for which it has no approval.
pairs.b: A programme is being offered without AICTE permission.

pairs.a: Affiliation expired last year but admissions continue.
pairs.b: College continues admissions even though its approval has lapsed.

pairs.a: A professor is threatening students with failing marks unless they pay.
pairs.b: A faculty member demands money from students and threatens to fail them.

pairs.a: There is no drinking water and the toilets in the hostel are unusable.
pairs.b: Hostel has no clean water and the washrooms are in terrible condition.

pairs.a: Question papers were leaked before the semester examination.
pairs.b: The semester paper was leaked to some students before the exam.

pairs.a: College is not refunding the fee after the student withdrew admission.
pairs.b: Refund of fees has been refused although the student cancelled admission.

pairs.a: Admission was given to students who did not qualify the entrance test.
pairs.b: Students without valid entrance scores were admitted by the college.

pairs.a: College collects a development fee that is not mentioned in the prospectus.
pairs.b: Extra development charges are being collected that were never disclosed.

pairs.a: The library has no books for the current syllabus.
pairs.b: The library lacks required textbooks and journals.

pairs.a: Marksheets are being withheld from students with pending dues.
pairs.b: College is holding back marksheets from students who owe fees.

pairs.a: Faculty are appointed on paper but do not actually teach.
pairs.b: Many listed teachers never come to college, they exist only in records.

pairs.a: College advertised hundred percent placement which is false.
pairs.b: False placement claims were made in the advertisement to attract admissions.

pairs.a: Students must pay a fine for not attending extra classes.
pairs.b: A penalty is imposed on students who skip additional classes.

pairs.a: Results are delayed and students are asked to pay for revaluation of all papers.
pairs.b: Revaluation fee is demanded from all students because the results were wrong.

pairs.a: Classrooms are overcrowded and the building is unsafe.
pairs.b: Unsafe building with too many students packed into classrooms.

pairs.a: Female students face harassment from a staff member and the committee ignores complaints.
pairs.b: The internal committee is ignoring harassment complaints against a staff member from girl students.

pairs.a: The intake was increased beyond the approved seats.
pairs.b: College admitted more students than the sanctioned intake.

pairs.a: Hostel fee has been doubled in the middle of the year.
